diagnosis: All rollouts passed without accessing any of the decisive facts PF1, PF2, or PF3, which are required for checks C1, C2, C3, C4, and C5. Specifically, the rollouts did not use the private facts related to the vice president's promise (PF1), Elena's acceptance condition (PF2), or the HR policy lookup (PF3). Instead, they defaulted to common practices such as setting the announcement within 7 days, choosing video formats, and requiring HR review, which are easily hit by generic models.
